note: Gideon Kotzé: Short Notes on the Value of the Septuagint and Vulgate for the Interpretation of Lamentations 1:1. _Journal of Northwest Semitic Languages_ 36: 75–93. – Page 89: “By witnessing to the content of Lam 1:1 from different angles, the Greek and Latin translations furnish the exegete with unique interpretations of the verse that are well worth considering.”
